features: Unique Santa Tree Topper- This cute but untraditional Santa Christmas tree topper is a perfect way to top off your tree. Funny and unique design adds some joy and creative touch to your home decor during this holiday season

Superior Quality - The Santa Claus Christmas Tree Topper is made of premium quality polyester, non-woven, plush and metal. Fine craftsmanship and heavy duty material that make it durable and can be reusable for the years to come. Spot clean only

Funny Design –This adorable tree topper features a Santa face with curved beard and small eyes. It wears a colorful top hat adorned with festive trim, green mittens that drapes down the front of your tree. Please note: the diameter of the Christmas tree topper is about 12 inch, it suit for most of standard size Christmas tree.

Easy to Install – Iron metal inside the Santa’s arms make it adjustable. You can make he pose and keep it in place easily on any Christmas trees. (Please note that the Santa head and hat are hallow, but still stands up stiff when you put it over branch. If branch is not long enough to keep Santa's head up, you may have to stuff it. )
Great Addition for Christmas Holidays - Have your Christmas tree ready for the season with our unique Santa Christmas Tree Topper. A must buy for home party décor.
